before.rationale: Count unordered three-card selections subject to the equal-sum constraint, splitting into disjoint cases according to the group containing card 1. Anchoring that group avoids counting permutations of the three groups.

after.rationale: All three unordered groups must sum to 15. The published method uses parity to find the unique all-odd group, either {1,5,9} or {3,5,7}, and completes the two other groups. A parity-free route anchors the group containing card 1: it is either {1,5,9} or {1,6,8}; completing each remaining partition gives one arrangement. The odd/even node is specific to the first route, not shared support.
